metadata.source: CAAS AIP Singapore AD-2-WSSL-ADC-1-1 and AD-2-WSSL-ADC-1-2

C6_WP_W1.label: Stand Charlie Six via Whiskey Papa to holding point Whiskey One
C6_WP_W1.completionControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, contact Seletar Tower on one one eight decimal four five.

W1_RWY21_LINEUP.label: Whiskey One to runway Two One line-up
W1_RWY21_LINEUP.completionControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, runway two one, cleared for takeoff.

RWY21_TAKEOFF.label: Runway Two One takeoff roll and lift-off
RWY21_TAKEOFF.completionControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, airborne. Exercise complete.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: Seletar Ground, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, Cessna one seven two at stand Charlie Six, request taxi runway two one.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, taxi to holding point Whiskey One, runway two one, via Whiskey Papa. Hold short of runway two one.
steps.hint: Call Seletar Ground with your callsign, stand, aircraft type, assigned runway, and taxi request.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: Taxi via Whiskey Papa to holding point Whiskey One, hold short of runway two one, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, readback correct. Taxi via Whiskey Papa to Whiskey One.
steps.hint: Read back taxiway Whiskey Papa, holding point Whiskey One, runway two one, and the hold-short instruction.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: One one eight decimal four five, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, contact Seletar Tower.
steps.hint: Read back the Tower frequency: one one eight decimal four five.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: Seletar Tower, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, holding short at Whiskey One, runway two one, ready for departure.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, runway two one, line up and wait.
steps.hint: Tell Tower your callsign, Whiskey One holding position, runway two one, and that you are ready for departure.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: Line up and wait runway two one, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, readback correct. Line up and wait runway two one.
steps.hint: Read back runway two one and the full line-up-and-wait instruction.

instruction.approvedSpokenText: Cleared for takeoff runway two one, 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha.

steps.successControllerText: 9 Victor Bravo Charlie Alpha, readback correct. Cleared for takeoff runway two one.
steps.hint: Read back your callsign, runway two one, and the takeoff clearance.
